newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Anglovaal cautions on three more firms.
newsitem.headline: Anglovaal cautions on three more firms.

text.p: South African group Anglovaal Ltd said on Thursday that shareholders in three more firms should exercise caution in their dealings due to the proposed reorganisation of its mining and mineral interests
The firms are Eastern Transvaal Consolidated Mines Ltd, Hartebeestfontein Gold Mining Co Ltd and Loraine Gold Mines Ltd.
On Wednesday Anglovaal urged caution to shareholders in Anglovaal Holdings, Middle Witwatersrand (Western Areas) Ltd and Target.
Anglovaal said a further announcement, which would include the terms of the proposed reorganisation, was expected to be made later this month.
